answer: Random beacon audits with compute heartbeats stop bulk fakes at the jetty where agents dock. Each applicant posts a 20-unit deposit and an opal-stamped heartbeat; the beacon samples 5% each epoch and demands a fresh echo of work within 10 minutes. Missing two echoes burns the deposit and closes the slot. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 20 = 2000 units plus steady compute, while one honest agent pays 20 units once and earns undiluted rewards.
